t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ndichitiya ukaboni, O Chiuta wango, kuti mukundilenga kuti ndikuziweni ndikumusopani Imwe. Ndikhozga, panyengu yinu, kufowka kwangu ndikukuwa kwanthazi zinu, kusawuka kwangu ndikulemera kwinu. Palivi Chiuta munyaki kweni Imwi-pe, wakovya pasoka, wambura kusowa kanthu.
